scope: RefyllRx luxury/minimal frontend and connected Supabase project
method: Static source review plus live Supabase schema/RLS/policy inspection and rollback-only authorization tests

remediated_findings.title: Secure-message history could be modified by authenticated patients
remediated_findings.evidence: secure_messages UPDATE policy allowed a patient access to every message with their patient_id; UPDATE privilege has now been revoked and messages are append-only.

remediated_findings.title: Patient could modify professional credential fields on own profile
remediated_findings.evidence: Rollback test confirmed a patient-role JWT could update licence_number/licence_college/prescriber_type. A server trigger now blocks this unless app role is super_user.

remediated_findings.title: Refill and delivery request fields trusted browser-supplied medication/workflow data
remediated_findings.evidence: Server triggers now verify medication ownership/status, derive refill drug name, and force safe initial workflow values/timestamps.

remediated_findings.title: Direct assessment inserts could bypass the assessment consent-recording workflow
remediated_findings.evidence: Direct INSERT privilege/policy removed; assessment submission is bound to auth.uid() through a constrained RPC that writes consent records atomically.

remediated_findings.title: Submitted workflow records were overly mutable
remediated_findings.evidence: Assessment intake, refill patient fields, and delivery patient fields are now immutable after creation.

remediated_findings.title: Browser package lacked a strict CSP/security headers and used inline auth scripts
remediated_findings.evidence: Inline modules externalized; Netlify _headers now sets CSP, HSTS, anti-framing, nosniff, no-referrer and Permissions-Policy.

remediated_findings.title: app.js contained a module parse defect in assessment tab binding
remediated_findings.evidence: Rewritten event-binding block now parses and imports successfully as an ES module.

remediated_findings.title: Unused legacy clinical-decision table remained writable from browser-authenticated staff sessions
remediated_findings.evidence: Authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE privileges and write policies on public.assessments were removed pending a scoped clinical authorization model.

residual_findings.title: Professional MFA is not enforced
residual_findings.recommendation: Implement Supabase MFA challenge/enrollment and require JWT aal2 for staff/professional RLS paths.

residual_findings.title: Administrative and clinical roles are not cleanly separated
residual_findings.recommendation: Do not let super_user imply prescriber. Use separate admin and clinical claims plus credential/scope checks before re-enabling clinical decision writes.

residual_findings.title: Google/OAuth onboarding can create authenticated accounts before full demographic/registration-consent completion
residual_findings.recommendation: Add a server-enforced onboarding-complete gate before clinical assessment submission.

residual_findings.title: Session tokens are stored in localStorage using a custom implicit OAuth client
residual_findings.recommendation: Longer term, use official Supabase Auth with PKCE or a server-managed HttpOnly-cookie architecture; retain strict CSP.

residual_findings.title: Insurance-card uploads are not malware-scanned
residual_findings.recommendation: Add quarantine/content inspection before staff opens uploaded documents.

residual_findings.title: Supabase leaked-password protection is disabled
residual_findings.recommendation: Enable it in Authentication password-security settings.

residual_findings.title: Authenticated SECURITY DEFINER assessment RPC triggers a Supabase advisor warning
residual_findings.recommendation: Current checks make it intentional; long term move privileged implementation out of the exposed public schema or to an Edge Function.

positive_controls: All public application tables inspected have RLS enabled.
Authorization roles are read from app_metadata, not user_metadata.
No service-role key or private database credential is present in the frontend package.
Insurance-card bucket is private, owner-folder scoped, MIME restricted and limited to 5 MB.
Dynamic database content inserted into innerHTML is HTML-escaped in the reviewed rendering paths.
OAuth and password-recovery redirects are hardcoded to the RefyllRx site rather than caller-controlled URLs.
